title: Budget vs Deposit Exposure
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:checklist`), seating revisions (`event:seating`), vendor contracts (`event:vendor`), deposits (`event:deposit`), planning syncs (`event:sync`).
app: Wedding and event-planning telemetry — The Knot checklist exports, seating-chart revisions, vendor deposit schedules, and RSVP operations — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:deposit vendor_type=* deposit_exposure_pct=*
| stats avg(deposit_exposure_pct) as avg_deposit_exposure_pct, count as events by vendor_type
| sort - avg_deposit_exposure_pct
description: Shows average deposit exposure percentage by vendor type for budget exposure.
value: Average deposit exposure percentage by vendor type helps compare budget exposure across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `deposit_exposure_pct` on `event:deposit` events and normalize `vendor_type` so Splunk can summarize performance by vendor type.
visualization: Bar chart of average deposit exposure percentage by vendor type.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers the average deposit exposure percentage for each vendor type so you can see what works best for budget exposure.
